_comment: SCE Mesh §16.4 / RFC F.X-3 Stage D — runtime vsomeip config for the brake_left_part SCE binary (sce-mesh-parent netns, 172.16.10.1). Hosts the consolidated SCE app `brake_region_liveness_brake_left_part_sce` (RFC F.X-2) which both offers the partition's own §16.4 liveness service (0x8180, port 30571) and registers the availability handler for the sibling `brake_right_part`'s liveness service (0x8181). SD over multicast 224.244.224.245:30490 with pinned timings (RFC F.X-3 D9 / `feedback_vsomeip_sd_cross_host.md`): set_reliable(true) is emitted by the codegen template, the `services` block declares the offered service's reliable.port explicitly, and the SD initial_delay / repetitions are tightened to 10..50ms / 100ms × 3 so cross-host convergence completes inside the 500 ms two-host orchestrator settle window instead of the vsomeip default seconds.
